caseNameFull: McCrea v. Michigan Wilcox v. Michigan Way v. Michigan Landsberg v. Michigan Elliott v. Michigan Stambaugh v. Michigan and Malone v. Michigan
attorneys: Messrs. William E. Leahy and Nicholas J. Chase for petitioners in Nos. 651 and 771; and Mr. John A. Bresnahan for petitioners in Nos. 738, 739, 740, 741, and 742. Messrs. Herbert J. Rush-ton, Attorney General of Michigan, and Daniel J. O’Hara, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Michigan denied. The stay orders heretofore entered are vacated.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
